column1: # The v3 CEGAR branches, measured through KLEE.
# codex-v3 only: it appends to ifaceflag_t, so a KLEE built against master's
# headers can load it by LD_LIBRARY_PATH alone. claude-v3 still inserts
# BV_TERM_ABSTRACTION_DIVMOD mid-enum, which shifts five of the flags KLEE
# sets, so it cannot share a sweep with anything else and is measured
# separately against a KLEE rebuilt on its headers.
# Abstraction is off in the first two rows because that is what KLEE's tuned
# configuration uses; the -abs rows are what these branches exist to change.
# label <TAB> backend <TAB> LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libstp (or -) <TAB> extra klee args
